theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbsf_tg_weak_limit_gluing
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (M E : Set (Euclid P)) (S : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (u : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ) (v D : Euclid P → ℝ), MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet E → (∀ j, MeasurableSet (S j)) → Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (S i) (S j)) → (∀ j, S j ⊆ M) → μ (M \ ⋃ j, S j) = 0 → IntegrableOn D M μ → (∀ k, AEStronglyMeasurable (u k) (μ.restrict M)) → (∀ k, ∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.restrict M), ‖u k x‖ ≤ D x) → IntegrableOn v (M ∩ E) μ → (∀ j, Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x in S j, u k x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in S j ∩ E, v x ∂μ))) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x in M, u k x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in M ∩ E, v x ∂μ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
